record.reason: Layer pruning is applied to reduce memory for federated LLM fine-tuning, and experiments evaluate training memory/communication and task quality. The paper studies backpropagation/federated adaptation, not inference-time serving or generation latency. Its pruning mechanism could intersect model compression, but current evidence is training-only.
record.title: Memory-Efficient Federated Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models via Layer Pruning
